question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 7.**
solution:
The correct answer is: sold

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given words. 
 
 
• **Purchased **means buying something.
 
• **Funded **means to provide a project, school, charity etc. with money.
 
• **Donated **means to give money or goods to an organization, especially one for people or animals who need help.
 
• Sold means to transfer goods or render services in exchange for money.
 
 
 
• As per the meaning of the given words Sold is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Hence, the correct answer is: option 4.

Several school children participated **__(6) in__** this noble initiative. They collected old newspapers and books and **__(7) sold__** them to raise a good sum of money which was (8)______ used to buy kits. The children were happy to (9)______ and learnt how taking care of each other is very (10)______ in such challenging situations.*
